name: p6-r20-researcher-smoke
brief:
R20 SMOKE — end-to-end proof that the researcher role resolves and runs. Keep this project TINY; it exists only to exercise ONE researcher task and ONE reviewer task. Do not expand scope, do not add extra rounds, do not add builders.

ROUND 0 (you, the architect): create EXACTLY TWO tasks — and nothing else. No planning corpus, no phases, no planners, no builders. Use the /api/projects/<id>/tasks curl printed in your prompt: it already carries THIS project's real UUID. Read that UUID out of the curl and substitute it for every occurrence of the token PROJECT_ID below before you paste the reviewer brief.

  Task A — round 1, role "researcher", tier "junior", title "Perplexity API surface and pricing". Its brief is the ROUND 1 text below, pasted verbatim.
  Task B — round 2, role "reviewer", tier "standard", title "Spot-check the Perplexity research". Its brief is the ROUND 2 text below, pasted verbatim, with PROJECT_ID replaced by this project's actual UUID.

Both tasks must exist before you finish: the round-2 reviewer is the only thing standing between this smoke and a green "done" project that proves nothing, and neither the researcher nor the engine will create it for you (a researcher is explicitly forbidden from creating tasks). The engine text appended after this brief asks you for a PLAN.md — a single paragraph naming the two tasks satisfies it; it does not license any third task. Then STOP. Your final message is the two tasks you created, with their ids.

--- ROUND 1 (paste as Task A's brief) ---
Research the CURRENT Perplexity API: the available endpoints and their request/response surface, the model names it exposes, and the current pricing (per-token rates and any per-request or per-search fees). Use WebSearch/WebFetch; steer a browser only if the plain fetch path fails. Prefer docs.perplexity.ai and the official pricing page over blog aggregators.

Include AT LEAST 3 CITED SOURCE URLs. Every claim that matters — an endpoint name, a model name, a price — must sit next to the URL you actually read it on. State plainly what you could not verify rather than guessing.

Commit your findings to the docs/research/*.md file the engine names for you at the end of this prompt. Do not invent a different filename and do not create a second file: exactly one new markdown file under docs/research/, committed in this scratch worktree.
--- END ROUND 1 ---

--- ROUND 2 (paste as Task B's brief, PROJECT_ID substituted) ---
Spot-check the round-1 research. Locate it by globbing: run `ls -la docs/research/` and `git log --oneline -3` — the engine names the researcher's file, so do NOT assume any particular filename. If docs/research/ contains no markdown file committed by round 1, that alone is NEEDS_FIXES; say so and stop.

Otherwise: open AT LEAST 2 of the URLs the researcher cited and compare what those pages actually say against the claims in the file, quoting the relevant line from each page you opened. A citation that does not support its claim, a dead URL, or fewer than 3 cited sources is NEEDS_FIXES.

On PASS, close this project yourself with:
  curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7700/api/projects/PROJECT_ID/status -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{"status":"done"}'
and paste the response into your final message. End with the VERDICT line either way.
--- END ROUND 2 ---

This is a scratch project: there is no live checkout to protect and nothing to deploy. Do not touch /opt/forge-ai-os. Do not restart any pm2 process.
